description: Resource Type definition for AWS::SageMaker::EndpointPolicy. Attaches a resource policy to a SageMaker endpoint. The policy grants other AWS accounts access to the endpoint, for example through a SageMaker Inference Router. An endpoint has at most one resource policy, which is removed when the endpoint is deleted.

EndpointArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the endpoint the policy is attached to. The endpoint must be in the same account and Region as the stack.

EndpointName.description: The name of the endpoint the policy is attached to.

PolicyDocument.description: The resource policy document, as a JSON object. The service returns the document in its canonical form, so specify principals as full ARNs (for example arn:aws:iam::111122223333:root) and keep the form the service returns, to avoid drift.
